world.title: Neon River Tunnel Odyssey
world.description: A swirling river of neon pink and blue liquid flows through a metallic, purple-hued tunnel. Golden rings encircle the tunnel, which is lined with small, glowing perforations. To the left, the metallic wall continues with golden structural ribs and rows of circular vents emitting a soft violet glow. To the right, a mirrored section of the tunnel wall extends, with floating iridescent bubbles drifting near the vibrant stream. Opposite the focal point, the tunnel opens into a vast control chamber. Above, the arched ceiling features bright golden light strips. Below, the floor is submerged beneath the rushing, luminous liquid.
